name: web-crypto-gold-exchange-hero-with-3d-safe-coins-and-gold-bars
title: 'Exchange your gold with our crypto' dark hero with 3D safe, coins, gold bars and a BUY sign
whatItIs: A black landing page hero with a yellow outlined 'Log In' button, a white headline, a yellow 'Sign Up now' pill, a 3D scene of a black safe with a Bitcoin coin, stacked gold bars, floating coins, a 'BUY' sign and chess-pawn user figures in gold, silver and black, soft golden glows and partner logos (Binance, Coinbase).
whatItMeans: Premium and secure; gold 3D props tie crypto to the trust of physical wealth.
techniques: Build a 3D hero scene from symbolic props.
Use gold glows on black for luxury.
List partner logos as trust signals.
Add a hatched circle accent near the headline.

vocabulary.definition: A composition of rendered objects telling a story.
Partner brand marks shown for credibility.
